decision.metric: dialogue CER, rubi path (scoring.path), console view

components.hval_page: the decision metric: every hval page's whole-dialogue regions (base, +4, +8 px; vocr6-ingest's page pool, which keeps every other box out of a region) through the C finder VOCR_LINES_TEXTBOX_RECOVERY (+ refinement on PSP) in the console view, over the region units whose finder output has no junk box (a finder box covering no reference line); merged lines, missed lines and the finder's imperfect crops all count; clusters = titles; without the units that hold a train-seen line (stage 1 amendment 3)
components.hval_page_all: the same over every unit, junk boxes included (report)
components.hval_clean: hval dialogue lines as clean crops, clusters = titles (report)
components.dev: 0.25 tv + 0.25 dn + 0.5 wd (VOCR5's development score, console view) without dev_exclude_vns, clusters = VNs, tv/dn/wd resampled independently
components.hval_page_seen: hval_page with the train-seen units kept (report)

decision.adopt: Y over X iff the hval_page interval of mean(Y) - mean(X) lies below 0, every seed pair's hval_page point difference is below 0, and the dev interval does not lie above 0 (plans/vocr6-plan.md section 7: better on hval page-path dialogue CER and not worse on the unseen-game dev sets, game-bootstrap 95% intervals, across seeds)

page_metric_evidence.measured: 2026-10-26 09:30-09:50Z, before any VOCR6 run, on VOCR5 blobs only (the released v5f_N_seed3, the other VOCR5-N seeds v5f_N_seed1/2, VOCR5-S, VOCR5-L): CER points, title-bootstrap 95% intervals (5,000 resamples)
page_metric_evidence.junk_units: 413 of 6,327 region units (6.5%, 5.6% of the reference characters) have a finder box that covers no line; on one title (PCSG00854) the finder boxes an ornament band above the text, which models read as 'そしtu0100...' (one kana passes Rubi's non-Japanese filter)
page_metric_evidence.conclusion: over all units the page path ranks recognizers by what they read into junk boxes on one title (the same recipe's seeds differ by up to 0.8 points); without the junk units it agrees with the clean crops and the dev score and resolves 0.1-point differences. Junk boxes stay a finder problem (vocr6-finder, T3) and a stage-2 recognizer factor (empty-label negatives), reported as hval_page_all.

A15.what: full fine-tune of VOCR5-N (its own fine-tuned checkpoint, seed 1 = v5f_N_seed1, seed 3 = the released v5f_N_seed3)

B15.what: VOCR5-N's synthetic-only pretrain (pre5_N_seed*, 150,000 steps of nv + s2 + s3v3 + s4, never a real line), then this fine-tune

C50.what: random init, the same mix from the first step (the pretrain's lr 2e-3, 1,000 warm-up steps)

decision.primary: the long budgets A45, B45, C150 (converged accuracy); short budgets and the short -> long gain are reported with each run's slot-hours (cost)
decision.incumbent: VOCR5-N as released (v0.3.0 VOCR5_N_w8.vocr = v5f_N_seed3 step 15000), scored on the same plans; for each pair it is X for both seeds
decision.winner: W1 = the long-budget arm with the lowest mean hval_page CER whose dev interval against VOCR5-N does not lie above 0. W2 = the next lowest if W1 is not adopted over it (decision.adopt); W2 is carried into stage 2 only if it is another family and costs no more new slot-hours than W1
decision.budget: stage 2 and 3 screen at the winner family's short budget; stage 4 uses the long budget iff long is adopted over short for W1 (decision.adopt, the short runs as X)
decision.seen: VOCR5 trained on the owner's console captures of 38 of the 49 hooked titles' VNs (vocr6-ingest overlap): arm A and the VOCR5 incumbents carry that exposure into hval; the screening copies of the owner pool and teacher_train drop the rows that repeat an hval line (data_pins.guarded), so B, C and A's new steps do not see them
decision.compute: est. N: ~6,250 steps per slot-hour (VOCR5-N's fine-tunes: 15,000 steps in 2 h 24 min); A15/B15 ~2.4 h, A45/B45 ~7.2 h, C50 ~8 h, C150 ~24 h per run; 12 runs ~102 slot-hours

Cost (exact, #130): +40,000 B int8 weights per tier, +12,288 / +30,720 / +49,152 B arena at 256 / 640 / 1,024 px; est. +35 ms per nominal 3-line box for Normal at 333 MHz on top of the gate + two-level head (758 -> 794 ms)

S3rep.what: RepCBR re-parameterisation branches on the stem and depthwise convs, training only (fused into the plain blob: same bytes, same speed); from R2's init the extra branches start at 0. VOCR3's 5k-step pretrain proxies: -0.49 [-0.73, -0.26] (docs/vocr3-arch-candidates.md); never trained at full length; trains ~1.6x slower

S3gtc.what: an auxiliary attention-decoder (NRTR, GTC) loss on the frame features, training only (never exported), at weight 0.1: the earlier test at weight 1.0 from scratch was +3.08 at 5k steps (docs/vocr3-arch-candidates.md: 're-test only with a lower weight'), here a lower weight and a warm start
